description: Closed: email59 carries no marketing email, so this answers marketing_not_allowed. Marketing email to up to 1,000 recipients; the unsubscribe link is added for you. Invalid, role, blocked or unsubscribed recipients are skipped and cost nothing; each accepted recipient uses 1 email of today's allowance. A campaign that doesn't fit what's left today is refused whole. With send_at, local_time + timezone, {{name}} fields or recipient objects it is kept and each recipient gets its own email at its own time (allowance spent as each goes out).

from.description: Name before the @ (e.g. hello). The domain is always email59.com. Optional.

list_id.description: Your name for this audience, used for unsubscribes.

local_time.description: Instead of send_at: HH:MM in timezone, the next such time.

recipients.description: Recipient addresses, or objects with their own merge values and send time (max 1,000).

send_at.description: ISO 8601 with its offset; overrides the campaign's.

timezone.description: IANA name; alone it takes the campaign's local_time in this zone.

send_at.description: When it goes out: ISO 8601 with its offset, 1 minute to 30 days ahead. Empty = now.

name: send_campaign
title: Send a marketing campaign
